questions.question: This time tomorrow, I _____ on the beach.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم المستقبل المستمر للتعبير عن حدث سيكون جاريًا في وقت محدد في المستقبل.

questions.question: At 9 p.m. tonight, she will be _____ (study).
questions.explanation_ar: يتكون المستقبل المستمر من will be ثم الفعل مع ing.

questions.question: I will call you when I _____ home.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد when عند الحديث عن المستقبل نستخدم المضارع البسيط في جملة الزمن.

questions.question: You will miss the bus _____ you hurry.
questions.explanation_ar: Unless تعني ما لم، والجملة تعني أنك ستفوت الحافلة إذا لم تسرع.

questions.question: You cannot enter the room _____ you have a ticket.
questions.explanation_ar: Unless تعني ما لم، أي لا يمكنك دخول الغرفة إلا إذا كان لديك تذكرة.

questions.question: I do not like coffee. I do not like tea _____.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم either في نهاية الجملة المنفية لإضافة معلومة منفية مشابهة.

questions.question: _____ of the two answers is correct. Both are wrong.
questions.explanation_ar: Neither تعني لا واحد من الاثنين، وهي مناسبة لأن الإجابتين خاطئتان.

questions.question: _____ my parents work in the city. (two people)
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم Both عند الحديث عن شخصين أو شيئين معًا.

questions.question: The film was _____ interesting that I watched it twice.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم so قبل الصفة، ويتبعها that لبيان النتيجة.

questions.question: It was _____ a beautiful day that we went to the beach.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم such قبل عبارة الاسم التي تبدأ غالبًا بأداة وصفية وصفة.

questions.question: Choose the correct phrase.
questions.explanation_ar: الترتيب الشائع للصفات هو الرأي ثم الحجم ثم المادة، وبعدها الاسم.

questions.question: Correct the phrase: A red big car.
questions.explanation_ar: يأتي وصف الحجم عادةً قبل اللون، لذلك نقول big red car.

questions.question: This exercise is _____ than the previous one.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم more قبل الصفات الطويلة للمقارنة بين شيئين.

questions.question: My sister is as tall _____ my mother.
questions.explanation_ar: التركيب as + adjective + as يستخدم للتعبير عن تساوي الصفة بين شيئين.

questions.question: Put the words in the correct order: does / where / live / your uncle
questions.explanation_ar: يبدأ السؤال بأداة الاستفهام، ثم does، ثم الفاعل، ثم الفعل الأساسي.

questions.question: Match each travel word with its Arabic meaning.
questions.explanation_ar: هذه الكلمات مهمة عند السفر وحجز الفنادق والتنقل.

questions.question: Where do hotel guests usually check in?
questions.explanation_ar: يتم تسجيل دخول النزلاء عادةً عند مكتب الاستقبال.

questions.question: If you turn right, which direction do you go?
questions.explanation_ar: Turn right تعني انعطف إلى اليمين.

questions.question: When you do not understand someone, you can ask them to _____ the question.
questions.explanation_ar: Repeat تعني يكرر، ويمكن طلب إعادة السؤال عند عدم فهمه.

questions.question: You feel _____ when something unexpected and amazing happens.
questions.explanation_ar: Surprised تعني متفاجئ أو مندهش.

questions.passage: The students are planning a trip to a nature reserve. Their teacher has asked everyone to bring a water bottle, a hat, and a notebook. They will leave school at seven in the morning and return before three in the afternoon. During the visit, a guide will explain how animals and plants live in the reserve. The students must stay with their groups and never feed wild animals.
questions.question: Where are the students planning to go?
questions.explanation_ar: يذكر النص أن الطلاب يخططون لزيارة محمية طبيعية.

questions.passage: The students are planning a trip to a nature reserve. Their teacher has asked everyone to bring a water bottle, a hat, and a notebook. They will leave school at seven in the morning and return before three in the afternoon. During the visit, a guide will explain how animals and plants live in the reserve. The students must stay with their groups and never feed wild animals.
questions.question: What time will the students leave school?
questions.explanation_ar: سيغادر الطلاب المدرسة في الساعة السابعة صباحًا.

questions.passage: The students are planning a trip to a nature reserve. Their teacher has asked everyone to bring a water bottle, a hat, and a notebook. They will leave school at seven in the morning and return before three in the afternoon. During the visit, a guide will explain how animals and plants live in the reserve. The students must stay with their groups and never feed wild animals.
questions.question: Why should students never feed wild animals?
options: To protect the animals and follow safety rules
Because the animals are all asleep
Because the guide does not like food
questions.correct_answer: To protect the animals and follow safety rules
questions.explanation_ar: هذا استنتاج مناسب من تعليمات حماية الحيوانات واتباع قواعد السلامة في المحمية.

questions.question: Correct the sentence: She is the most tallest girl in the class.
questions.correct_answer: She is the tallest girl in the class.
questions.explanation_ar: لا نجمع بين most و-est في صيغة التفضيل؛ نستخدم tallest وحدها.

questions.question: Imagine you are planning a one-day trip. Write four sentences about where you will go, what you will take, and what you will do.

criteria: Mention at least two things to take.
Describe at least one planned activity.
rubric.sample_answer: I am going to visit a nature reserve. I will take a water bottle and a hat. I will walk with my family. I hope to see some birds.

questions.explanation_ar: اكتب خطة رحلة قصيرة، واذكر المكان والأشياء التي ستأخذها والأنشطة التي ستقوم بها.
